description: This file defines an abstract class `Player` that encapsulates common media playback operations and supports different implementations like remote and local players. It provides methods for playback control, queuing, statistics, and presentation updates, along with a factory method for creating instances based on route information.

classes.name: Player
classes.description: An abstract class for media playback handling with methods for playing, pausing, stopping, seeking, and managing playlists. It supports different player implementations based on the route.

methods.name: isRemotePlayback
methods.description: Indicates whether the player performs remote playback.

methods.name: isQueuingSupported
methods.description: Indicates if advanced queuing operations are supported.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified route.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the player.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of the specified playlist item.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in the specified playlist item.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the specified playlist item.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues a playlist item; supported if queuing is supported.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a playlist item by ID.

methods.name: updateStatistics
methods.description: Updates route statistics; default implementation empty.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Returns route statistics as a string.

methods.name: updatePresentation
methods.description: Updates presentation display; default implementation empty.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback for player events.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a Player instance based on route info.

search-terms: abstract Java class for media playback
